description: Move a folder, with everything in it, inside another folder or out to the top level. It goes last among its new neighbours. Refused if it would put anything more than three levels deep, or a folder inside itself.

folder_id.description: Folder id, as returned by list_folders.

parent_id.description: The folder this one goes inside, as returned by list_folders. Omit it for the top level.

name: scratchpad_move_folder
title: Move folder
